name: A Celebrated Ethnologist
summary: An unnamed scholar consulted by the narrator regarding the ancient Philistine legend of Dagon, the Fish-God, though the narrator abandoned his inquiries upon judging the man hopelessly conventional.
description: The narrator sought out this celebrated ethnologist and questioned him about the ancient Philistine legend of Dagon, the Fish-God, hoping perhaps for insight into his own harrowing experience. Finding the man hopelessly conventional in his views, the narrator did not press his inquiries further.

sources.quote: Once I sought out a celebrated ethnologist, and amused him with peculiar questions regarding the ancient Philistine legend of Dagon, the Fish-God; but soon perceiving that he was hopelessly conventional, I did not press my inquiries.

facts: The narrator sought him out and asked him peculiar questions about the ancient Philistine legend of Dagon, the Fish-God.
He was perceived by the narrator as hopelessly conventional.
